pages.name: 首页
pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Recolor the attached actual desktop app mockup. EXACT source screenshot dimensions and layout. Preserve all existing panels, margins, titles, navigational logic, labels, Windows title-bar controls, original app icon, thumbnails and reference sticker illustrations. The user rejected all dark large UI surfaces, the blue surround, and the solid-colored title bar. Create a fresh fashion-editorial high-key design, entirely light UI surfaces with a vivid sophisticated color clash. Background airy warm porcelain #FFFCF8, sidebar warm white linen #FAF7F2 (not yellow beige, no blue). Dark aubergine-gray #342933 is for readable text and line icons only. Custom title bar is a single shallow ~55px designer composition, not a solid color and not a dark bar: left milk-lavender #F1E7FF behind the logo and precise product text “捞鱼创作台”, a large asymmetric angular butter-citron field #FFE985 across the middle-right and a pink grapefruit shape #FFB8AE overlapping it toward the right, window controls in dark ink on a calm pale pink endcap. Think clean large overlapping geometric paper fields, asymmetrical but not noisy. Make the title bar lighter than the previous screenshot, no dark fill or dark gradient, no faux lighting or paper noise. A brief grapefruit-coral pop plus lavender and lemon is intentional and contemporary. Accent button pastel coral #FFC0B6 with deep warm berry label #622934, no white-on-low-contrast, thin subtle neutral dividers, soft natural images. Preserve the character stickers as their original high-fidelity art without extra white outlines or altered colors. Maintain a precise realistic Chinese desktop application screenshot; no new panels, no decoration over controls, no poster frame, no background surrounding the app.
Page 01 HOME. Keep the two BGM 打标 and AI 辅助剪辑 cards in exact positions; BGM card light lilac (#F2E8FF) with violet waveform line, AI editing card soft butter yellow (#FFF1B6) with coral tiny playhead, both clear blush primary buttons “进入工作区”. Recent projects panel clean white warm surface. Selected left navigation “首页” uses a compact pale citron background, no fluorescent acid line. Preserve the prominent listening boy, waving girl and girl holding the orange editing prop at lower right with existing placements. Exact existing app copy on all labels. Make color collision clear while visually light; all large surfaces are light.
